summary: Verified admin 2FA email-removal + SMS method + master->luca rename + phone-based admin management. 5/6 pytest tests pass. Frontend chooser correctly shows TOTP/SMS/Backup (no email, phoneHint ****1745), TOTP login lands on dashboard with Export/Import/Admin AI, and Manage Admins create+edit-phone flow works end-to-end. Did NOT call /api/admin/2fa/sms/send (per instructions). One backend validation gap found: AdminCreate accepts null/missing phone despite spec saying phone is required.

minor.issue: AdminCreate model has phone: Optional[str] = None and accepts admin creation without phone (returned 200 with phone=null for payload lacking phone). Spec/UI label says 'Mobile phone (REQUIRED)'. Backend should reject with 422 when phone missing/empty.

action_items: Make phone required in AdminCreate (Pydantic: phone: str with constr(min_length=1) or validator); currently backend silently accepts admins without phones, which breaks the premise that SMS 2FA is always available for new admins.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCreate.phone should not be Optional per the new design (SMS method depends on it).
/api/admin/admins supports PATCH for phone edits but not for other fields consistently — confirmed PATCH works for phone update (used by UI edit-phone pencil).
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED: test_nophone (from backend validation test) and phonetest (frontend create/edit test). Final state: only luca remains. Luca's phone was briefly changed to 5559876543 by an incorrect UI parent-walk in the test script, then restored to 7017871745 via UI pencil edit — verified via GET /api/admin/admins.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_sms_2fa.py. Do NOT call /api/admin/2fa/sms/send — real SMS costs. Phone-edit UI testid pattern: admin-row-edit-phone-<id>, admin-row-phone-input-<id>, admin-row-phone-save-<id>. Admin update uses HTTP PATCH (PUT returns 405). Luca's id is 4a300b41-e856-4332-8f67-16f1b0a4d1d1 in this env.
rca of the issue: Phone-required gap: AdminCreate declares phone as Optional[str]=None at /app/backend/server.py:104, and the create route (around line 1235) just normalizes None -> None without validation. Fix: change to `phone: str` + Pydantic validator that rejects empty strings after normalization, matching the required=true HTML attribute already present in AdminsManager.jsx.
